# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.20

## What's New

**StreamDek Fuse**
Bring Live TV and on-demand libraries from your plugins, add-ons and playlists into one destination
on Home. Browse collections, filter your sources, search their catalogues and keep favourite
channels close by. Sources without catalogue search search only the titles already loaded from
them. Enable Fuse in Settings; it is off by default and the choice is saved on this device.

**Next Up in Continue Watching**
After you finish an episode, the series card can offer its next aired episode, including the next
season when available. Episodes you are part-way through keep their resume position. Continue
Watching now considers both your last playback and a next episode's air date, so a series can move
back towards the front when a new episode arrives.

**Arrange Home by source or mix your rows**
Home rows now offers **By source** and **Mixed** organisation. Move a whole source and its rows
together, or arrange individual rows from different sources in any order. Search for a row or
source, filter to rows that are switched on, and use drag handles or move controls to reorder.
Switching modes preserves your arrangement, and the settings belong to your profile.

**Bring your device setup into a profile**
When setting up a new profile, choose to bring across your device's watch progress, watchlist,
favourite channels, sources, preferences and Home layout. Existing profile data is kept, and your
local setup is not deleted. You can also start this from Settings or retry an incomplete transfer.

**CloudStream source choices follow your profile**
Source switches inside supported CloudStream extensions now sync between Mobile and TV. Changes
are merged individually, so changing different switches on different devices preserves both, and
an older device's defaults do not overwrite newer choices.

## Improvements

- Refreshed theme palettes and the theme picker, including Aurora and Monochrome treatments.
- Navigation Behaviour now offers **Fixed**, **Scroll-Aware**, **Auto-Collapse** and
  **Collapse on Scroll**, with clearer descriptions of how navigation and page headers behave.
  Fixed headers stay at the top while content scrolls beneath them.
- New Episodes controls now sit with Home settings. Hiding the New Episodes row leaves episode
  notifications enabled.
- Live channel and favourites lists remain available while another channel is connecting, so you
  can choose a different channel without waiting for the current attempt to finish.
- More resilient CloudStream plugin loading and improved support for M3U stream headers and
  playback cookies required by some providers.

## Fixed

- Fixed live-channel favourites failing to recognise the same channel under different identifiers.
- Fixed Back cancelling a channel switch before closing an open channel or favourites drawer.
- Fixed older paused progress overriding a newer unwatched action and holding back Next Up.
- Fixed Next Up ordering overlooking a newly aired episode when the previous episode was watched
  earlier.
